views.name: Parts List (Cont.)
views.caption: Parts List (Cont.)

views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Disconnect all four servos from the Nano I/O Module. Set everything aside except the Base Servo (No Dot).
views.caution: Keep the parts you set aside in a safe place to prevent them from getting lost or damaged. You will need them again soon.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Disconnect all four servos from the Nano I/O Module. Set everything aside except the Base Servo (No Dot).
views.caution: Keep the parts you set aside in a safe place to prevent them from getting lost or damaged. You will need them again soon.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Tilt the Base Servo (No Dot) and push its servo horn down through the cutout in R1. Then, turn the servo and set it into the slot, with its wires at the notched end.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Tilt the Base Servo (No Dot) and push its servo horn down through the cutout in R1. Then, turn the servo and set it into the slot, with its wires at the notched end.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Slide R2 over the Base Servo, fitting the tabs of R2 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Slide R2 over the Base Servo, fitting the tabs of R2 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of R3 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of R3 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of R4 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of R4 into the slots in R1.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Attach R5 to the left tab of R4 and the right tab of R3.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Attach R5 to the left tab of R4 and the right tab of R3.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Attach R6 to the remaining tabs on R3 and R4. Keep the Base Servo's wires clear of the tabs.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Attach R6 to the remaining tabs on R3 and R4. Keep the Base Servo's wires clear of the tabs.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Place the Base Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R4.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Place the Base Servo's wires into the hook-shaped slot in R4.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Slide B2 under the servo horn until the servo sits in the round cutout.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Slide B2 under the servo horn until the servo sits in the round cutout.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Lower B1 onto B2 so the servo horn fits into the cutout in B1.
views.caution: If the servo horn is not lined up, you may need to adjust it so that it fits in the B1 cutout.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Lower B1 onto B2 so the servo horn fits into the cutout in B1.
views.caution: If the servo horn is not lined up, you may need to adjust it so that it fits in the B1 cutout.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Attach B1 and B2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Attach B1 and B2 using a 6mm screw.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Attach B1 and B2 using the other five 6mm screws.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Attach B1 and B2 using the other five 6mm screws.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of B3 into the slots near the end of B2.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Push the bottom tabs of B3 into the slots near the end of B2.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Insert B4 into the center slot in B2.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Insert B4 into the center slot in B2.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Slide the Left Joystick into B5.
views.caution: Keep the breadboard wires connected to the Nano I/O Module. The Left Joystick is wired to A2 and A3.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Slide the Left Joystick into B5.
views.caution: Keep the breadboard wires connected to the Nano I/O Module. The Left Joystick is wired to A2 and A3.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Slide B6 onto the Left Joystick.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Slide B6 onto the Left Joystick.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Place B5 and B6 on B3 and B4, fitting them into the slots in B2.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Place B5 and B6 on B3 and B4, fitting them into the slots in B2.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Slide the Right Joystick into B6.
views.caution: Keep the breadboard wires connected to the Nano I/O Module. The Right Joystick is wired to A0 and A1.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Slide the Right Joystick into B6.
views.caution: Keep the breadboard wires connected to the Nano I/O Module. The Right Joystick is wired to A0 and A1.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Slide B7 onto the Right Joystick.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Slide B7 onto the Right Joystick.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Place B6 and B7 on B3 and B4, fitting them into the slots in B2. Keep the joystick's wires clear.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Place B6 and B7 on B3 and B4, fitting them into the slots in B2. Keep the joystick's wires clear.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Place B8 on B5, B6, and B7.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Place B8 on B5, B6, and B7.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Slide the Nano I/O Module through the slots in both B6 pieces, tilted slightly. Then, lower it until it lies flat on B4.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Slide the Nano I/O Module through the slots in both B6 pieces, tilted slightly. Then, lower it until it lies flat on B4.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Reconnect the Base Servo (No Dot) to Row 5. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Reconnect the Base Servo (No Dot) to Row 5. Match the wires: brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.
